correctness.rationale: At a boundary zero q factor f=(z-q)^ell g and choose a nonzero holomorphic ell-th root h of g; psi=(z-q)h gives exactly f=psi^ell and a local analytic Jordan boundary. Computing image-boundary signed curvature yields |g(q)|^(-1/ell)*(1+2 Re(qgprime(q)/g(q))/ell). Expanding the boundary graph in tangent-normal coordinates gives the occupied circular angular measure pi-kappa*rho+O(rho^2). Exact conformal Jacobian cancellation yields level element ell*rho^(ell-1) ds_w and area ell^2*|w|^(2ell-2) dA_w. Direct polar integration gives both claimed coefficients and remainder orders. The independently checked model f(z)=z-1 has circle-intersection arc angle 2 arccos(epsilon/2)=pi-epsilon+O(epsilon^3), validating sign and level coefficient and, by radial integration, the energy correction -epsilon^3/3. Interior-zero contributions are exactly the full-angle terms; compactness of the complement of zero neighborhoods controls the global sum.
